name: Build Kernel with KernelSU/SuKiSu + SUSFS

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      kernel_source:
        description: 'Kernel Source Repository'
        required: true
        default: 'https://github.com/user/kernel_source'
        type: string
      kernel_branch:
        description: 'Kernel Branch'
        required: true
        default: 'main'
        type: string
      kernel_defconfig:
        description: 'Defconfig Name'
        required: true
        default: 'vendor/device_defconfig'
        type: string
      ksu_variant:
        description: 'KernelSU Variante'
        required: true
        default: 'sukisu'
        type: choice
        options:
          - sukisu
          - kernelsu-next
          - none
      susfs_enabled:
        description: 'SUSFS aktivieren'
        required: true
        default: true
        type: boolean
      susfs_branch:
        description: 'SUSFS Branch (z.B. gki-android14-6.1)'
        required: false
        default: 'gki-android14-6.1'
        type: string
      clang_version:
        description: 'Clang Version'
        required: true
        default: 'r530567'
        type: string
      android_version:
        description: 'Android Version'
        required: true
        default: '14'
        type: choice
        options:
          - '12'
          - '13'
          - '14'
          - '15'
      kernel_version:
        description: 'Kernel Version (z.B. 5.15, 6.1, 6.6)'
        required: true
        default: '6.1'
        type: choice
        options:
          - '5.10'
          - '5.15'
          - '6.1'
          - '6.6'
      build_boot_image:
        description: 'Boot Image erstellen (AnyKernel3)'
        required: true
        default: true
        type: boolean

env:
  KERNEL_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/kernel_source
  CLANG_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/toolchain/clang
  ANYKERNEL_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/anykernel3
  OUT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/out
  SUSFS_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/susfs_src

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Cleanup Previous Builds
        run: |
          echo "Cleaning up previous build directories..."
          rm -rf $KERNEL_DIR || true
          rm -rf $CLANG_DIR || true
          rm -rf $ANYKERNEL_DIR || true
          rm -rf $OUT_DIR || true
          rm -rf $SUSFS_DIR || true

      - name: Setup Build Environment
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            git curl wget \
            build-essential \
            bc bison flex \
            libssl-dev libelf-dev \
            python3 python-is-python3 \
            zip unzip \
            libncurses-dev \
            lld llvm \
            cpio

      - name: Clone Kernel Source
        run: |
          rm -rf $KERNEL_DIR || true
          git clone --depth=1 -b ${{ inputs.kernel_branch }} \
            ${{ inputs.kernel_source }} $KERNEL_DIR

      - name: Download Clang Toolchain
        run: |
          mkdir -p $CLANG_DIR
          cd $CLANG_DIR
          
          # Google Clang herunterladen
          CLANG_URL="https://android.googlesource.com/platform/prebuilts/clang/host/linux-x86/+archive/refs/heads/main/clang-${{ inputs.clang_version }}.tar.gz"
          
          echo "Downloading Clang ${{ inputs.clang_version }}..."
          curl -LSs "$CLANG_URL" -o clang.tar.gz
          tar -xzf clang.tar.gz
          rm clang.tar.gz
          
          echo "CLANG_PATH=$CLANG_DIR/bin" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup KernelSU (SuKiSu)
        if: inputs.ksu_variant == 'sukisu'
        run: |
          cd $KERNEL_DIR
          
          echo "Setting up SuKiSu..."
          curl -LSs "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tiann/KernelSU/main/kernel/setup.sh" | bash -s v0.9.5-sukisu
          
          # SuKiSu-spezifische Patches anwenden falls vorhanden
          if [ -d "KernelSU" ]; then
            cd KernelSU
            git remote add sukisu https://github.com/ShirkNeko/SuKiSu.git || true
            git fetch sukisu
            git checkout sukisu/main -- . 2>/dev/null || echo "Using default SuKiSu setup"
            cd ..
          fi
          
          echo "KSU_VARIANT=sukisu" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup KernelSU Next
        if: inputs.ksu_variant == 'kernelsu-next'
        run: |
          cd $KERNEL_DIR
          
          echo "Setting up KernelSU Next..."
          curl -LSs "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tiann/KernelSU/main/kernel/setup.sh" | bash -s main
          
          # KernelSU Next Branch verwenden
          if [ -d "KernelSU" ]; then
            cd KernelSU
            git fetch origin next
            git checkout next 2>/dev/null || git checkout origin/next
            cd ..
          fi
          
          echo "KSU_VARIANT=kernelsu-next" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup SUSFS
        if: inputs.susfs_enabled
        run: |
          cd $KERNEL_DIR
          
          echo "Setting up SUSFS..."
          
          # SUSFS Repository klonen
          rm -rf $SUSFS_DIR || true
          git clone --depth=1 -b ${{ inputs.susfs_branch }} \
            https://gitlab.com/simonpunk/susfs4ksu.git $SUSFS_DIR
          
          SUSFS_SRC="$SUSFS_DIR/kernel_patches"
          
          # SUSFS Kernel Module kopieren
          if [ -d "$SUSFS_SRC/fs" ]; then
            cp -r "$SUSFS_SRC/fs/susfs.c" fs/ 2>/dev/null || true
            cp -r "$SUSFS_SRC/fs/susfs.h" fs/ 2>/dev/null || true
            cp -r "$SUSFS_SRC/include/linux/susfs.h" include/linux/ 2>/dev/null || true
          fi
          
          # SUSFS Patches anwenden
          PATCH_DIR="$SUSFS_SRC/50_add_susfs_in_${{ inputs.kernel_version }}"
          if [ -d "$PATCH_DIR" ]; then
            for patch in "$PATCH_DIR"/*.patch; do
              if [ -f "$patch" ]; then
                echo "Applying patch: $(basename $patch)"
                git apply --check "$patch" 2>/dev/null && git apply "$patch" || \
                  patch -p1 < "$patch" || echo "Patch failed: $patch (may already be applied)"
              fi
            done
          fi
          
          # KernelSU SUSFS Integration
          if [ -d "KernelSU" ]; then
            KSU_SUSFS_PATCH="$SUSFS_SRC/KernelSU/10_enable_susfs_for_ksu.patch"
            if [ -f "$KSU_SUSFS_PATCH" ]; then
              cd KernelSU
              git apply --check "$KSU_SUSFS_PATCH" 2>/dev/null && git apply "$KSU_SUSFS_PATCH" || \
                echo "KSU SUSFS patch may already be applied"
              cd ..
            fi
          fi
          
          echo "SUSFS_ENABLED=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Configure Kernel
        run: |
          cd $KERNEL_DIR
          
          export PATH="$CLANG_PATH:$PATH"
          
          # Base defconfig erstellen
          make O=$OUT_DIR ARCH=arm64 \
            CC=clang \
            CROSS_COMPILE=aarch64-linux-gnu- \
            CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32=arm-linux-gnueabi- \
            LLVM=1 \
            ${{ inputs.kernel_defconfig }}
          
          # KernelSU aktivieren
          if [ "${{ inputs.ksu_variant }}" != "none" ]; then
            echo "Enabling KernelSU in config..."
            echo "CONFIG_KSU=y" >> $OUT_DIR/.config
            echo "CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS=y" >> $OUT_DIR/.config
          fi
          
          # SUSFS Configs aktivieren
          if [ "${{ inputs.susfs_enabled }}" == "true" ]; then
            echo "Enabling SUSFS configs..."
            cat >> $OUT_DIR/.config << EOF
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_HAS_MAGIC_MOUNT=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_PATH=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MOUNT=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_AUTO_ADD_SUS_KSU_DEFAULT_MOUNT=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_AUTO_ADD_SUS_BIND_MOUNT=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_KSTAT=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_OVERLAYFS=n
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_TRY_UMOUNT=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_AUTO_ADD_TRY_UMOUNT_FOR_BIND_MOUNT=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SPOOF_UNAME=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_ENABLE_LOG=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_HIDE_KSU_SUSFS_SYMBOLS=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SPOOF_CMDLINE_OR_BOOTCONFIG=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_OPEN_REDIRECT=y
          CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_SU=n
          EOF
          fi
          
          # Config regenerieren
          make O=$OUT_DIR ARCH=arm64 \
            CC=clang \
            LLVM=1 \
            olddefconfig

      - name: Build Kernel
        run: |
          cd $KERNEL_DIR
          
          export PATH="$CLANG_PATH:$PATH"
          
          echo "Starting kernel build..."
          echo "KSU Variant: ${{ inputs.ksu_variant }}"
          echo "SUSFS Enabled: ${{ inputs.susfs_enabled }}"
          
          make -j$(nproc) O=$OUT_DIR ARCH=arm64 \
            CC=clang \
            CROSS_COMPILE=aarch64-linux-gnu- \
            CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32=arm-linux-gnueabi- \
            LLVM=1 \
            LLVM_IAS=1 \
            2>&1 | tee build.log
          
          # Prüfen ob Image erstellt wurde
          if [ -f "$OUT_DIR/arch/arm64/boot/Image" ]; then
            echo "Kernel Image built successfully!"
          elif [ -f "$OUT_DIR/arch/arm64/boot/Image.gz" ]; then
            echo "Kernel Image.gz built successfully!"
          else
            echo "ERROR: Kernel build failed!"
            tail -100 build.log
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create AnyKernel3 Package
        if: inputs.build_boot_image
        run: |
          echo "Preparing AnyKernel3 package..."
          
          rm -rf $ANYKERNEL_DIR || true
          git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/osm0sis/AnyKernel3.git $ANYKERNEL_DIR
          
          cd $ANYKERNEL_DIR
          
          # Template anpassen
          sed -i 's/do.devicecheck=1/do.devicecheck=0/g' anykernel.sh
          sed -i 's/do.modules=0/do.modules=0/g' anykernel.sh
          
          # Kernel Image kopieren
          if [ -f "$OUT_DIR/arch/arm64/boot/Image" ]; then
            cp $OUT_DIR/arch/arm64/boot/Image .
          elif [ -f "$OUT_DIR/arch/arm64/boot/Image.gz" ]; then
            cp $OUT_DIR/arch/arm64/boot/Image.gz .
          fi
          
          # DTBO kopieren falls vorhanden
          if [ -f "$OUT_DIR/arch/arm64/boot/dtbo.img" ]; then
            cp $OUT_DIR/arch/arm64/boot/dtbo.img .
          fi
          
          # DTB kopieren falls vorhanden
          find $OUT_DIR -name "*.dtb" -exec cp {} . \; 2>/dev/null || true
          
          # Unnötige Dateien entfernen
          rm -rf .git README.md
          
          # ZIP erstellen
          VARIANT="${{ inputs.ksu_variant }}"
          SUSFS_TAG=""
          if [ "${{ inputs.susfs_enabled }}" == "true" ]; then
            SUSFS_TAG="-susfs"
          fi
          
          ZIP_NAME="Kernel-${VARIANT}${SUSFS_TAG}-android${{ inputs.android_version }}-${{ inputs.kernel_version }}-$(date +%Y%m%d).zip"
          
          zip -r9 "${{ github.workspace }}/${ZIP_NAME}" * -x .git README.md
          
          echo "ZIP_NAME=${ZIP_NAME}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Upload Kernel Image
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: kernel-image
          path: |
            ${{ env.OUT_DIR }}/arch/arm64/boot/Image*
            ${{ env.OUT_DIR }}/arch/arm64/boot/dtbo.img
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload AnyKernel3 Package
        if: inputs.build_boot_image
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ env.ZIP_NAME }}
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/${{ env.ZIP_NAME }}
          if-no-files-found: warn

      - name: Create Release
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.build_boot_image
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ github.run_number }}-${{ inputs.ksu_variant }}
          name: "Kernel Build #${{ github.run_number }} - ${{ inputs.ksu_variant }}"
          body: |
            ## Kernel Build Information
            
            - **KSU Variant:** ${{ inputs.ksu_variant }}
            - **SUSFS:** ${{ inputs.susfs_enabled }}
            - **Android Version:** ${{ inputs.android_version }}
            - **Kernel Version:** ${{ inputs.kernel_version }}
            - **Clang:** ${{ inputs.clang_version }}
            - **Build Date:** ${{ github.event.repository.updated_at }}
            
            ### Features
            - KernelSU/SuKiSu Root Support
            ${{ inputs.susfs_enabled && '- SUSFS (Filesystem Hiding)' || '' }}
            - AnyKernel3 Flashable ZIP
          files: |
            ${{ github.workspace }}/${{ env.ZIP_NAME }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build Summary
        run: |
          echo "## Build Summary" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Setting | Value |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "|---------|-------|" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| KSU Variant | ${{ inputs.ksu_variant }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| SUSFS | ${{ inputs.susfs_enabled }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Android | ${{ inputs.android_version }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Kernel | ${{ inputs.kernel_version }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "| Clang | ${{ inputs.clang_version }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "✅ Build completed successfully!" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY                        e: docker_ksun

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      android_version:
        type: string
        default: android15
        required: true
      kernel_version:
        type: string
        default: "6.6"
        required: true
      sub_level:
        type: string
        default: "102"
        required: true
      os_patch_level:
        type: string
        default: "2025-10"
        required: true
      require_susfs:
        type: boolean
        default: true
        required: false
        - cgroup hierarchy: cgroupv2
  Controllers:
  - cpu: missing
  - cpuset: missing
  - io: missing
  - memory: missing
  - pids: missing
- CONFIG_NAMESPACES: enabled
- CONFIG_NET_NS: enabled
- CONFIG_PID_NS: enabled
- CONFIG_IPC_NS: enabled
- CONFIG_UTS_NS: enabled
- CONFIG_CGROUPS: enabled
- CONFIG_CGROUP_CPUACCT: enabled
- CONFIG_CGROUP_DEVICE: enabled
- CONFIG_CGROUP_FREEZER: enabled
- CONFIG_CGROUP_SCHED: enabled
- CONFIG_CPUSETS: enabled
- CONFIG_MEMCG: enabled
- CONFIG_KEYS: enabled
- CONFIG_VETH: enabled
- CONFIG_BRIDGE: enabled
- CONFIG_BRIDGE_NETFILTER: enabled
- CONFIG_IP_NF_FILTER: enabled
- CONFIG_IP_NF_MANGLE: enabled
- CONFIG_IP_NF_TARGET_MASQUERADE: enabled
- CONFIG_IP6_NF_FILTER: enabled
- CONFIG_IP6_NF_MANGLE: enabled
- CONFIG_IP6_NF_TARGET_MASQUERADE: missing
- CONFIG_NETFILTER_XT_MATCH_ADDRTYPE: enabled
- CONFIG_NETFILTER_XT_MATCH_CONNTRACK: enabled
- CONFIG_NETFILTER_XT_MATCH_IPVS: enabled
- CONFIG_NETFILTER_XT_MARK: enabled
- CONFIG_IP_NF_RAW: enabled
- CONFIG_IP_NF_NAT: enabled
- CONFIG_NF_NAT: enabled
- CONFIG_IP6_NF_RAW: enabled
- CONFIG_IP6_NF_NAT: missing
- CONFIG_NF_NAT: enabled
- CONFIG_POSIX_MQUEUE: enabled
- CONFIG_NF_NAT_IPV4: enabled
- CONFIG_NF_NAT_NEEDED: enabled

Optional Features:
- CONFIG_USER_NS: enabled
- CONFIG_SECCOMP: enabled
        echo "MKBOOTIMG=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/mkbootimg/mkbootimg.py" >> $GITHUB_ENV
    # --------------------------------------------------
    # KERNEL SOURCE
    # --------------------------------------------------
    - name: Init kernel source
      run: |
        cd "$KERNEL_ROOT"
        BRANCH="common-${{ inputs.android_version }}-${{ inputs.kernel_version }}-${{ inputs.os_patch_level }}"
        repo init -u https://android.googlesource.com/kernel/manifest -b "$BRANCH" --depth=1
        repo sync -c -j$(nproc) --no-tags --fail-fast
    # --------------------------------------------------
    # KernelSU-Next (OFFICIAL)
    # --------------------------------------------------
    - name: Add KernelSU-Next
      run: |
        cd "$KERNEL_ROOT"
        curl -LSs https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/next/kernel/setup.sh | bash -
    # --------------------------------------------------
    # SUSFS CORE (REQUIRED)
    #--------------------------------------------------
    - name: Apply SUSFS core patch (SAFE)
      if: ${{ inputs.require_susfs }}
      working-directory: ${{ env.KERNEL_ROOT }}/common
      run: |
        set -e
        PATCH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/susfs4ksu/kernel_patches/50_add_susfs_in_gki-android15-6.6.patch"
        echo "==> Applying SUSFS core patch (Pixel safe mode)"
        patch -p1 < "$PATCH" || true
    
        # 🔥 WICHTIG: proc/base rejects IMMER entfernen
        rm -f fs/proc/base.c.rej
        rm -f fs/proc/*.rej

    # --------------------------------------------------
    # SUSFS FIX PATCHES (OPTIONAL / SAFE)
    # --------------------------------------------------
    - name: Apply SUSFS fix patches (optional)
      working-directory: ${{ env.KERNEL_ROOT }}/common
      run: |
        set -e
        FIX="$KERNEL_PATCHES/wild/susfs_fix_patches/v2.0.0"
        apply_optional() {
        local p="$1"
        [ -f "$p" ] || return 0
        for lvl in 0 1 2; do
          if patch -p$lvl --dry-run < "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            patch -p$lvl < "$p"
            echo "✔ applied $(basename "$p")"
            return
            fi
          done
          echo "⚠ skipped $(basename "$p")"
          }
          apply_optional "$FIX/fix_task_mmu.c.patch"
          apply_optional "$FIX/1_fix_base.c.patch"
          rm -f fs/proc/*.rej
    # --------------------------------------------------
    # KERNEL CONFIG (CLEAN + SAFE + DOCKER + BBR)
    # --------------------------------------------------
    - name: Kernel config
      run: |
        cd "$KERNEL_ROOT"
        CFG="common/arch/arm64/configs/gki_defconfig"
        add() { grep -q "^$1=" "$CFG" || echo "$1=$2" >> "$CFG"; }
        # KernelSU
        add CONFIG_KSU y
        add CONFIG_KSU_MANUAL_HOOK y
        add CONFIG_KSU_MANUAL_SU n
        # SUSFS (Pixel SAFE)
        if [[ "${{ inputs.require_susfs }}" == "true" ]]; then
          add CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS y
          add CONFIG_TMPFS_XATTR y
          add CONFIG_TMPFS_POSIX_ACL y
          add CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_HAS_MAGIC_MOUNT y
          add CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_PATH y
          add CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SPOOF_UNAME y
          # ❌ UMOUNT = OFF (WLAN / MODEM SAFE)
          add CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_TRY_UMOUNT n
          add CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_AUTO_ADD_TRY_UMOUNT_FOR_BIND_MOUNT n
          add CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_SUS_MOUNT n
          add CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_AUTO_ADD_SUS_BIND_MOUNT n
          add CONFIG_KSU_SUSFS_ENABLE_LOG n
        fi
        # Namespaces (Docker)
        add CONFIG_PID_NS y
        add CONFIG_IPC_NS y
        add CONFIG_USER_NS y
        add CONFIG_POSIX_MQUEUE y
        add CONFIG_CGROUPS y
        add CONFIG_CGROUP_CPUACCT y
        add CONFIG_CGROUP_SCHED y
        add CONFIG_MEMCG y
        add CONFIG_BLK_CGROUP y
        add CONFIG_OVERLAY_FS y
        # BBR
        add CONFIG_TCP_CONG_ADVANCED y
        add CONFIG_TCP_CONG_BBR y
        add CONFIG_NET_SCH_FQ y
        sed -i 's/check_defconfig//' common/build.config.gki
        sed -i 's/-maybe-dirty//g; s/-dirty//g' common/scripts/setlocalversion
    # --------------------------------------------------
    # BUILD
    # --------------------------------------------------
    - name: Build kernel
      run: |
        cd "$KERNEL_ROOT"
        sed -i 's/BUILD_SYSTEM_DLKM=1/BUILD_SYSTEM_DLKM=0/' common/build.config.gki.aarch64
        sed -i '/MODULES_ORDER=android\/gki_aarch64_modules/d' common/build.config.gki.aarch64
        sed -i '/KMI_SYMBOL_LIST_STRICT_MODE/d' common/build.config.gki.aarch64
        tools/bazel build --config=fast //common:kernel_aarch64_dist
    # --------------------------------------------------
    # BOOT IMAGES
    # --------------------------------------------------
    - name: Prepare AVB key
      run: |
        mkdir -p kernel-build-tools/linux-x86/share/avb
        openssl genrsa -out kernel-build-tools/linux-x86/share/avb/testkey_rsa2048.pem 2048
        echo "BOOT_SIGN_KEY_PATH=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/kernel-build-tools/linux-x86/share/avb/testkey_rsa2048.pem" >> $GITHUB_ENV
    - name: Build boot images
      run: |
        cd "$KERNEL_ROOT/bazel-bin/common/kernel_aarch64"
        gzip -n -k -f Image
        lz4 -f Image Image.lz4
        for s in "" ".gz" ".lz4"; do
          k="Image$s"
          o="boot${s//./-}.img"
          [ -z "$s" ] && o="boot.img"
          $MKBOOTIMG --header_version 4 --kernel "$k" --output "$o"
          $AVBTOOL add_hash_footer \
            --partition_name boot \
            --partition_size $((64*1024*1024)) \
            --image "$o" \
            --algorithm SHA256_RSA2048 \
            --key "$BOOT_SIGN_KEY_PATH"
          cp "$o" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/${CONFIG}-$o"
        done
    - name: Upload boot images
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: boot-images-${{ env.CONFIG }}
        path: ${{ env.CONFIG }}-boot*.im
